novel_features.name: Daily snapshot delta
novel_features.description: One-line 'where you stand right now' for every playlist with today vs yesterday MMR and tier delta.
novel_features.rationale: Reads the last two locally-stored playlist snapshots and diffs them in one line. No public RL site gives a day-over-day delta in a single shell-readable line.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use peek when an agent needs a one-line read of a player's current standing plus today's movement, without fetching a full profile or computing differences itself.

novel_features.name: Time-series MMR curve
novel_features.description: Daily MMR series for one playlist over N days, suitable for piping into an agent or charting tool.
novel_features.rationale: Groups local SQLite snapshots by day for the chosen playlist_key. A single API call only returns 'right now' — the time series exists nowhere upstream.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use trend when an agent needs the curve of a player's rank over time to coach playlist focus or detect tilt patterns.

novel_features.name: Session summary
novel_features.description: Closes today's play session: start vs current MMR, W/L, most-played playlist.
novel_features.rationale: Filters locally-stored snapshots to rows captured since the local day boundary. Mirrors the surrounding rocket-league-stats project's explicit-boundary session model.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use session-summary when an agent needs to summarize 'how did today go' for a player without re-querying the API for every match.

novel_features.name: Group ranker
novel_features.description: Multi-player diff for a saved friend group, sortable by MMR delta, win delta, or MVP delta over N days.
novel_features.rationale: Joins locally-stored group membership with per-member snapshots. No public site offers a friend-group diff view sortable by user-chosen dimension.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use group when an agent needs to answer 'who in my crew improved most this week' or 'who tilted the hardest' — the inputs are local-only.

novel_features.name: Save a friend group
novel_features.description: Save a named friend group to local storage so the group ranker can query it.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local SQLite scaffolding. The grouping concept is unique to this CLI; no upstream API has it.
novel_features.example: rocket-league-tracker-pp-cli group save sundaynightgang SquishyMuffinz Apparently Vatira --platform epic
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use group save when setting up a tracked friend group; downstream commands like group and compare consume the saved set.

novel_features.name: Agent context blob
novel_features.description: Single agent-shaped JSON envelope: identity + last-30-day per-playlist MMR series + last 20 matches + current rank/tier + sweat-delta. Token-budgeted via --select.
novel_features.rationale: Joins three local tables into one envelope and exposes a flat selectable shape. Optimized for AI-agent ingestion; replaces hand-curated CSVs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use agent-context when an agent is asked to coach a player or recommend a playlist focus; this is the canonical structured input.

novel_features.name: Promo distance
novel_features.description: How many MMR points and approximate wins until the next tier promotion, per playlist.
novel_features.rationale: Combines /ranks/{playerId} with a baked-in static MMR-ladder reference. No wrapper in the absorb landscape computes this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use promo when an agent needs an actionable 'how close to next rank' for a player without computing tier ladders itself.

novel_features.name: Tournament fit
novel_features.description: Lists active tournaments whose skill bracket includes the player's current MMR for the relevant playlist.
novel_features.rationale: Joins /ranks/{playerId} with /tournaments and bracket thresholds. The cross-call filter is what no single endpoint supplies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use tournament-fit when an agent needs to recommend tournaments a player can actually queue for.

novel_features.name: Best queue time
novel_features.description: From historical population snapshots, the hour of week with the largest active queue for a playlist.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates locally-stored /population snapshots by hour-of-week. A single call gives 'now' only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use population-best-time when an agent needs to recommend when a player should queue for fastest matches.

novel_features.name: MMR sparkline
novel_features.description: ASCII sparkline of MMR over the last 30 days for the chosen playlist.
novel_features.rationale: Same series as trend, formatted as a glanceable terminal sparkline. Cheap incremental cost.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use mmr-curve when a human-readable terminal output beats JSON; agents should prefer trend.

novel_features.name: Liar check
novel_features.description: Verifies a player's claimed rank against their actual current MMR; returns 'true' or 'overstated by N MMR'.
novel_features.rationale: Compares /ranks/{playerId} to the static MMR-ladder lower bound for the claimed tier. The ritual the friend-group sweat persona literally needs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use liar-check when an agent needs to validate a claimed rank against ground truth without manually looking up tier thresholds.

novel_features.name: Import collector snapshot
novel_features.description: Pulls a JSON snapshot exported by the rocket-league-stats apps/collector process into the CLI's local store.
novel_features.rationale: The CLI shares the surrounding project's storage_key model, so collector data and RapidAPI data merge into one timeline. Unique to this CLI.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use import-collector-snapshot when a user has both the rocket-league-stats collector running and this CLI; the merge unlocks unified history.

narrative.headline: Every Rocket League rank lookup, plus a local SQLite store that turns 'right now' into 'last 30 days' — without a website, without a scraper.
narrative.value_prop: Rocket League Tracker CLI absorbs every command competing wrappers offer (profile, rank, stat, search, leaderboard, shop, tournaments) and adds local-only insights nobody else can: peek for daily MMR delta, trend for the time series, group for friend-group diff views, agent-context for an AI-agent-ready blob, promo for distance to the next tier, tournament-fit for matchmaking-aware tournament filters. Backed by RapidAPI's rocket-league1 listing; no scraping, no Cloudflare clearance, no TRN approval needed.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authentication is a single RapidAPI key. Sign up at rapidapi.com, find 'Rocket League by Stannis', subscribe to BASIC (free), copy your key. Set RAPIDAPI_KEY in your env or run `rocket-league-tracker-pp-cli auth set-key` to write it to local config. The free tier permits roughly 50 requests per day; the CLI's adaptive limiter surfaces 429s as typed errors so you can see a throttle, not a silent empty result.

quickstart.comment: Write your RAPIDAPI_KEY to local config so subsequent commands work without env-var setup.
Look up a known pro by Epic name; confirms key and reachability.
One-line summary with day-over-day MMR delta after at least two snapshots exist.
Time-series MMR for an agent loop; --select keeps token budget tight.

troubleshoots.fix: Set RAPIDAPI_KEY=<your-key> in your env, or run `rocket-league-tracker-pp-cli auth set-key` to store it in the local config file.

troubleshoots.symptom: Requests start returning 429 Too Many Requests.
troubleshoots.fix: RapidAPI's free tier caps requests around 50/day. Wait until tomorrow or upgrade to a paid plan in the RapidAPI dashboard. The CLI's adaptive limiter will back off automatically.
Run `sync <player>` at least twice on different days to seed the local store; transcendence commands need at least two snapshots to compute a delta.

The community RapidAPI listing may have been removed by the operator. Check https://rapidapi.com/rocket-league-rocket-league-default/api/rocket-league1; if the listing is gone, no replacement is currently available.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or terminal user wants Rocket League rank/MMR/playlist data for any player without opening a browser, and when the workflow benefits from a local time series (daily delta, weekly trend, friend-group diff). Prefer it over generic HTTP calls when the agent needs `--json --select` field-level control or typed exit codes for rate-limit errors. Skip it when the workflow is replay-based (use Ballchasing instead) or RLCS-pro-only (use Octane.gg).

recipes.explanation: One-line snapshot suitable for a morning agent prompt; assumes RL_USER is set and the local store has at least two snapshots.

recipes.command: rocket-league-tracker-pp-cli group save sundaygang Mason Priya Theo --platform epic
recipes.explanation: Save a named group once; it persists in local SQLite for reuse by the group ranker.

recipes.title: Rank the group by who improved most
recipes.explanation: Run after group save. Sorts saved members by 7-day MMR delta — pipes cleanly into a Discord webhook.

recipes.explanation: Token-budgeted blob with dotted-path field selection — nested playlists arrays narrow to only what the agent needs.

recipes.explanation: Returns the gap to the next tier and an estimated win count to get there for every playlist.

recipes.explanation: Returns true or 'overstated by N MMR' against the static tier ladder.
